conflict_group_limit: These are product-owned groups of registered style choice IDs, not a rule for arbitrary configuration keys. In particular, the three var categories are described as independent csharp_style_var_* editorconfig keys, so the declared group does not prove those external keys are mutually exclusive or specify invocation behavior.

omitted_boolean_interpretation.known_choice_complete_data: For a registered ID in a complete vocabulary, an ID absent from a complete Boolean property_set is false for that property. For example, wrap-splittable-expressions is absent from oracle_endorsed, so oracle_endorsed is false; its full value resource explicitly records false.
omitted_boolean_interpretation.unknown_id: An ID absent from the registered members is unknown/unregistered; do not infer a Boolean false for it.
omitted_boolean_interpretation.incomplete_data: If member coverage or the Boolean map coverage is incomplete, absence does not establish false; its value is unknown from the available data.
omitted_boolean_interpretation.unavailable_property: If the Boolean property is unavailable, its value is unavailable; do not treat the missing set or entry as false.
